name: Wrong statement format is rejected and the matching format is accepted
title: SC-07-06-02 Wrong statement format is rejected and the matching format is accepted
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site statement format is EXCEL
When the manager uploads an MT940 statement
Then the upload is rejected with a format mismatch error and nothing is queued
And uploading a matching Excel statement succeeds
